name: backup-assets-enable-transition-deadlock
title: 备份资产启用事务死锁修复
description: 修复 settings PUT 启用备份资产时同一 goroutine 重入 backupAssetMutationMu 导致请求永久挂起的问题，补齐可取消/有界的真实回归测试与发布复验。
creator: weibo
notes: Planning complete pending explicit user approval. Production v0.50.3 is healthy with backup_assets.enabled absent after a controlled restart. The confirmed root cause is a deterministic same-goroutine settings snapshot re-entry while WithBackupAssetMutation owns the mutation lock; Content prepare and Search startup both contain affected reads. The planned repair uses one validated prospective snapshot, config-aware runtime transitions, a context-aware exclusive gate, bounded joined cleanup, and exact rollback. Do not retry production enablement before a fixed release passes acceptance.
